ladder.classBlurb: The Sorcerer's blood stirs with veiled magic, spells that blur and bend what others see.
The Sorcerer's magic burns with both infernal and celestial fire, a halo of flame around their head.
The Sorcerer's magic is wild and powerful, but dangerous, sparking in unpredictable ways.
The Sorcerer's magic is drawn from the deep, heavy and cold as the bottom of the sea.
The Sorcerer's power flows from the heart of the world, a deep well of magic that never runs dry.
The Sorcerer's magic reaches the stars, calling down fire from beyond the horizon.
The Sorcerer's flames burn nothing into existence, consuming magic itself.
The Sorcerer's power comes from before their own birth, magic that the world forgot it ever gave.
The Sorcerer's blood carries the first spark of magic, a mortal flame from the dawn of the world.

subclasses.ds: Sorcery from a psionic taint — telepathy and mind magic. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A sorcerer descended from a star that fell rather than one that still burns, calling down delayed bursts of radiant ruin.
A wild magic sorcerer who has learned to direct their chaos, turning randomness into a weapon.
Sorcerers infused with the power of cosmic order. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
Sorcery inherited from a celestial parent or ancestor. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
Magic inherited from a dragon ancestor — extra durability and a growing elemental affinity tied to that dragon's damage type.

Dragonblood expands the fantasy and gameplay style of the Sorcerer class.
 This subclass focuses on a unique identity, combat role, and spell progression.
Gnome Bloodline is a Sorcerous Origin for the Sorcerer class, tracing its power to Earth and the dead earth spirit Gnome.
Ignis Bloodline is a Sorcerous Origin for the Sorcerer class, tracing its power to Fire and the dead fire spirit Ignis rather than a dragon.
Sorcerers empowered by the phases of the moon. (Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen)
A sorcerer whose magic reflects and duplicates, turning opponents' spells against them.
Sorcery touched by the Shadowfell. (File is named to avoid clashing with this vault's Shadow Magic spell school.) (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
Sorcery tied to wind, thunder, and lightning. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
Sylph Bloodline is a Sorcerous Origin for the Sorcerer class, tracing its power to Air and the dead air spirit Sylph.
Undine Bloodline is a Sorcerous Origin for the Sorcerer class, tracing its power to Water and the dead water spirit Undine.
A sorcerer born already touched by the Void rather than by any bloodline, resistant to force and able to silence nearby spells.
Magic drawn from raw chaos rather than any bloodline — unpredictable, occasionally spectacular, and never fully controlled.

ladder.classBlurb: The Warlock makes deals with hidden patrons, beings of fog and mirror who trade in secrets.
The Warlock signs contracts with devils and angels, wielding the power of binding deals.
The Warlock gambles with chaotic patrons, betting their power for even greater rewards.
The Warlock pays a tithe to patrons in the deep, drawing on dark power from below.
The Warlock binds their pact to their heart, making it part of their very life.
The Warlock's pacts extend across worlds, binding patrons from beyond the stars.
The Warlock breaks free from all patrons, drawing on the power of nothing instead.
The Warlock trades in forgotten debts, collecting on deals no one remembers making.
The Warlock makes a pact with the first Laws of the world, binding power older than gods.

subclasses.ds: Diamond's Patron is an Otherworldly Patron for the Warlock class — the patron being Diamond's shattered remains rather than a Fiend or Great Old One.
Iron's Patron is an Otherworldly Patron for the Warlock class — the patron being Iron himself, sealed away rather than dead, closer to an Undying patron than a Fiend or Great Old One.
A pact with a lord or lady of the Feywild. (Player's Handbook)
A patron that is little more than a burnt-out watcher, seeing everything through smoke and ash and wanting little in return.
A pact with a being from the Upper Planes. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A patron of the deep ocean. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A pact with a devil, demon, or other fiend from the lower planes — a patron who rewards dealing death with resilience and, eventually, the power to banish enemies outright.
A patron who is a noble genie of one of the four elements. (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything)
A pact with an alien entity beyond the stars. (Player's Handbook)
A pact with a sentient weapon from the Shadowfell. (Xanathar's Guide to Everything)
A patron that is an empty crown and an empty throne, nothing more, granting authority borrowed rather than earned.
A patron whose hunger consumes light itself, feeding the warlock on wounds dealt to the already-dying.
A patron that is a powerful undead being. (Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft)
A patron who has cheated death. (Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide)
A warlock whose patron dwells in the absolute void between planes. They wield the power of absolute nothingness.
